target: forge.sh pr-create (gitlab) — one create request with source, target, title and description from the body file; prints only the web URL
cmd:
. "$FIXTURES/forge/setup.sh"; fx_init
fx_remote https://gitlab.example.test/grp/sub/proj.git
export FORGE_TOKEN=glpat-FAKE-not-a-real-token-0001
PID=grp%2Fsub%2Fproj
fx_http "GET /api/v4/projects/$PID/merge_requests?source_branch=feat&state=opened" 200 '[]'
fx_http "POST /api/v4/projects/$PID/merge_requests" 201 '{"iid":5,"web_url":"https://gitlab.example.test/grp/sub/proj/-/merge_requests/5"}'
fx_run pr-create --head feat --base main --title "My title" --body-file body.md; fx_show r
echo "stdout_lines=$(printf '%s\n' "$FX_OUT" | wc -l | tr -d ' ')"
echo "posts=$(fx_nmeth POST)"
fx_reqs
fx_done
